newsitem.title: JAPAN: Itochu says no comment on naphtha dispute.
newsitem.headline: Itochu says no comment on naphtha dispute.

text.p: Itochu Corp on Thursday remained silent over allegations of naphtha price manipulation brought by South Korean petrochemical companies.
"We are not ready to comment on the issue at the moment," an Itochu spokesman said.
Seven South Korean petrochemical firms said on Wednesday they would suspend physical dealing with Itochu until April arrival cargoes, accusing the Japanese trading house of price-rigging.

The seven companies are Daelim Industrial Co, LG Petrochemical Co, Korea Petrochemical Industry Co, Honam Petrochemical Corp, Samsung General Chemicals Co, Hyundai Petrochemical Co and Hanwha Chemical Corp.
"Current naphtha prices have been totally overvalued and manipulated by one Japanese trader, Itochu Corp," they said in a joint statement.

The petrochemical firms said Japanese spot quotes had been distorted since last week, mainly because of Itochu's purchase of February cargoes despite weaker crude prices and softer European naphtha prices.
